title: Trace System + trace session Commands
description: Implement the complete named-session trace infrastructure with live write-on-call semantics: TraceEntry records (dual session identity: UUID + name), TraceWriter (live append to user-specified export path; security header exclusion), TraceSession (sessions.json index; UUID primary key; name non-unique; status: active|closing|closed), TraceConfigStore (trace-config.json default export path), and all eight trace subcommands (session start/list/export/close/reopen/remove + config set/show).
prerequisiteState: Stories 1-5 complete. ApiClient is deployed and working. IOutputWriter wired. No trace infrastructure exists yet.
goal: After 'zapi-cli trace session start --name my-session', every subsequent api call automatically writes a trace entry live to the resolved export file with security headers excluded. The trace file is always current — no export step needed to capture calls. 'zapi-cli trace session close' waits for in-flight calls, then seals the session. Sessions survive process exits and can be reopened to append further calls.
scope: Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/TraceEntry.cs with ApiTraceEntry and PexTraceEntry sealed records as defined in tech_spec.md §5. ApiTraceEntry fields: Seq (int), Type ('api' constant), Session (required string — name), SessionId (required string — UUID), Timestamp (required DateTimeOffset), DurationMs (int), Account (required string), Method (required string), BaseUrl (required string — scheme+host+port only via uri.GetLeftPart(UriPartial.Authority)), Url (required string — full URL), RequestHeaders (Dictionary<string,string> — security headers excluded), RequestBody (string?), ResponseStatus (int), ResponseHeaders (Dictionary<string,string> — set-cookie/www-authenticate excluded), ResponseBody (string?), Error (string?). PexTraceEntry fields: Seq, Type ('pex'), Session, SessionId, Timestamp, Account, RelatedApiSeq (int?), HandlerClass (required string), CallbackMethod (required string), Payload (required string).

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/ITraceSession.cs interface with: Task<TraceSessionEntry?> GetActiveSessionAsync(ct); Task<TraceSessionEntry> StartSessionAsync(string name, string exportPath, ct); Task CloseSessionAsync(string sessionId, int waitMs, ct); Task ReopenSessionAsync(string sessionId, ct); Task RemoveSessionAsync(string sessionId, ct); Task<IReadOnlyList<TraceSessionEntry>> ListSessionsAsync(ct); Task<int> IncrementEntryCountAsync(string sessionId, ct); Task<TraceSessionEntry?> FindByIdAsync(string sessionId, ct); Task<IReadOnlyList<TraceSessionEntry>> FindByNameAsync(string name, ct).

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/TraceSession.cs implementing ITraceSession. Manages <configDir>/traces/sessions.json. TraceSessionEntry sealed record: UniqueId (string), Name (string), StartTime (DateTimeOffset), ExportPath (string), EntryCount (int), Status ('active'|'closing'|'closed'). Name is NOT unique — two sessions may share a name. UUID is the primary key. CloseSessionAsync: (1) under Mutex set status to 'closing'; (2) wait waitMs ms; (3) under Mutex set status to 'closed'. ReopenSessionAsync: under Mutex set status to 'active'. IncrementEntryCountAsync: under Mutex read+increment+write entryCount, return new value as seq. Mutex name: 'Global\\zapi-cli-trace-{sessionUniqueId}' (keyed by UUID, not name). WaitOne(2000); drop entry silently on timeout.
Session name validation in StartSessionAsync: allow only [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], max 64 chars; throw ZapiCliException(INVALID_ARGS, 1) if invalid. No uniqueness check — names are non-unique.

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/TraceConfigStore.cs: manages <configDir>/trace-config.json. TraceConfig sealed record: DefaultExportPath (string?). Methods: Task<TraceConfig> LoadAsync(ct); Task SaveAsync(TraceConfig config, ct). Create ITraceConfigStore interface for DI.

Export path resolution in StartSessionAsync: (1) if --export-path given and ends in .json → use as exact file path; (2) if --export-path given and is a directory → resolve to <exportPath>/<name>-<uuid-short>.json where uuid-short is first 8 chars of UUID; (3) if no --export-path given, use DefaultExportPath from trace-config.json as directory + same naming; (4) if neither, throw ZapiCliException('No export path specified. Set a default with trace config set --default-export-path or use --export-path.', EXPORT_PATH_NOT_SET, 1). Add EXPORT_PATH_NOT_SET to ErrorCodes.

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/TraceWriter.cs: constructor injects ITraceSession, ILogger<TraceWriter>. Methods: Task AppendApiEntryAsync(ApiTraceEntry entry, ct), Task AppendPexEntryAsync(PexTraceEntry entry, ct). Implementation: (1) GetActiveSessionAsync — if null, return silently; (2) check session Status — if 'closing' or 'closed', return silently (log Warning for 'closing'); (3) IncrementEntryCountAsync for seq; (4) strip security headers (request: Authorization, Cookie, X-Auth-Token, X-Api-Key; response: Set-Cookie, WWW-Authenticate) using case-insensitive comparison — use 'entry with { ... }' record copy, never mutate original; (5) serialize safeEntry to one JSON line; (6) Directory.CreateDirectory for the parent directory of ExportPath; (7) append to ExportPath (UTF-8 no BOM, FileMode.Append). All failures caught and logged at Warning level — never rethrow.
Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/ITraceWriter.cs interface with AppendApiEntryAsync and AppendPexEntryAsync.

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Trace/TraceExporter.cs: reads trace file at ExportPath line by line; deserializes to JsonElement; applies typeFilter (api|pex); applies truncateBodyChars to request_body and response_body string fields in the output only (file content unchanged). Returns IReadOnlyList<JsonElement>. Resolves session via FindByIdAsync (by UUID) or FindByNameAsync (by name, throw SESSION_AMBIGUOUS if multiple match). If session not found, throw ZapiCliException with SESSION_NOT_FOUND exit 1.

Integrate TraceWriter into ApiClient.CallAsync: inject ITraceWriter into ApiClient constructor. After receiving response (or catching transport exception), build ApiTraceEntry with SessionId from active session's UniqueId and Session from its Name. BaseUrl = uri.GetLeftPart(UriPartial.Authority). Call _traceWriter.AppendApiEntryAsync. Trace write failure must NOT propagate — TraceWriter already catches internally.
Add new ErrorCodes: SESSION_NOT_FOUND (exit 1), SESSION_AMBIGUOUS (exit 1), EXPORT_PATH_NOT_SET (exit 1).
Create src/ZapiCli/Commands/TraceCommands.cs with these command classes:

StartSessionSettings: [CommandOption('--name')] required string Name, [CommandOption('--export-path')] string? ExportPath. StartSessionCommand.ExecuteAsync: resolves export path (injects ITraceConfigStore to read default); calls TraceSession.StartSessionAsync; WriteJson({ status='ok', data = { unique_id, name, export_path, start_time, status='active' } }).
ListSessionsCommand.ExecuteAsync: calls TraceSession.ListSessionsAsync; WriteJson array of { unique_id, name, start_time, entry_count, status, export_path }.

ExportSessionSettings: [CommandOption('--id')] string? Id, [CommandOption('--name')] string? Name (one required), [CommandOption('--truncate-body')] int? TruncateBody, [CommandOption('--type')] string? Type. ExportSessionCommand.ExecuteAsync: resolves session by id or name (ambiguity check); calls TraceExporter.ExportAsync; IOutputWriter.WriteJson the resulting list.

CloseSessionSettings: [CommandOption('--id')] string? Id, [CommandOption('--name')] string? Name (one required), [CommandOption('--wait-ms')] int WaitMs = 5000. CloseSessionCommand.ExecuteAsync: TraceSession.CloseSessionAsync(sessionId, waitMs); WriteJson({ status='ok', data = { unique_id, name } }).

ReopenSessionSettings: [CommandOption('--id')] string? Id, [CommandOption('--name')] string? Name (one required). ReopenSessionCommand.ExecuteAsync: TraceSession.ReopenSessionAsync(sessionId); WriteJson({ status='ok', data = { unique_id, name, status='active' } }).

RemoveSessionSettings: [CommandOption('--id')] string? Id, [CommandOption('--name')] string? Name (one required). RemoveSessionCommand.ExecuteAsync: TraceSession.RemoveSessionAsync(sessionId); WriteJson({ status='ok', data = { unique_id, name } }). Note: trace file at ExportPath is preserved.

TraceConfigSetSettings: [CommandOption('--default-export-path')] required string DefaultExportPath. TraceConfigSetCommand.ExecuteAsync: loads existing config (or create new), saves with new DefaultExportPath; WriteJson({ status='ok', data = { default_export_path } }).
TraceConfigShowCommand.ExecuteAsync: loads TraceConfig; WriteJson({ default_export_path }).

Register ITraceSession (TraceSession), ITraceWriter (TraceWriter), ITraceConfigStore (TraceConfigStore) as singletons in Program.cs DI. Register all commands under 'trace session' and 'trace config' branches in CommandApp.

Unit tests: security headers absent from written file (TraceWriter strips them); session name validation rejects 'bad/name'; if no active session api call succeeds with no trace file created; trace file is non-destructive on export (byte count unchanged); --truncate-body truncates output but file retains full content; session list returns correct entryCount; RemoveSession removes sessions.json entry but preserves file; ReopenSession sets status to 'active'; ReopenSession appended entries have seq continuing from previous entryCount; CloseSession sets status to 'closed'; SESSION_AMBIGUOUS thrown when --name matches multiple sessions; EXPORT_PATH_NOT_SET thrown when no export path configured.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
trace session start --name test returns success with unique_id, export_path; sessions.json entry created with status 'active'
api call after session start writes exactly one entry to the resolved export_path file immediately
Trace file does NOT contain 'authorization', 'cookie', 'x-auth-token', or 'x-api-key' keys in request_headers
Trace file does NOT contain 'set-cookie' or 'www-authenticate' keys in response_headers
trace session export --id <uuid> returns a JSON array; trace file byte count is identical before and after
trace session export --type api returns only entries with type='api'
trace session export --truncate-body 100 truncates body fields in output; trace file retains full content
trace session close --id <uuid> marks status='closed' in sessions.json; trace file preserved
trace session close waits for in-flight calls (CloseSessionAsync sets 'closing' then 'closed' with waitMs gap)
trace session reopen --id <uuid> sets status back to 'active'; subsequent api call appends to existing file with seq continuing from last entryCount
trace session remove --id <uuid> removes sessions.json entry; trace file at export_path is preserved
trace session start with invalid name (e.g. 'bad/name') → INVALID_ARGS, exit 1
trace session start with no export path and no default configured → EXPORT_PATH_NOT_SET, exit 1
trace config set --default-export-path <path> persists to trace-config.json; trace config show returns it
Two sessions with the same name can coexist; each has a different unique_id
trace session export --name <name> when two sessions share that name → SESSION_AMBIGUOUS, exit 1
api call when no session is active → proceeds normally, no trace file created, no error
Concurrent trace appends integrity maintained via UUID-keyed Mutex (entryCount correct)
TraceWriter failure does NOT propagate to the api call result
All unit tests pass
contextForAgent: Mutex keyed by UUID not name: 'Global\\zapi-cli-trace-{sessionUniqueId}'. Storage: <configDir>/traces/sessions.json (index) and <configDir>/trace-config.json (config). Trace file is at the user-specified ExportPath — NOT inside <configDir>. Name is non-unique; UUID is the primary key for all internal operations. CLI commands resolving by --name must call FindByNameAsync and throw SESSION_AMBIGUOUS if count > 1. GetActiveSessionAsync returns the most recently started active session (if any). Status transitions: active → closing (set by close, step 1) → closed (set by close, step 3 after waitMs). ReopenSessionAsync: set status back to active. TraceWriter sees 'closing' → log Warning + drop entry silently. TraceWriter sees 'closed' → return silently (GetActiveSessionAsync returns null for closed sessions; only 'active' sessions are returned). Security header exclusion must happen in TraceWriter via record copy ('entry with { RequestHeaders = safeHeaders, ResponseHeaders = safeResponseHeaders }'). BaseUrl = uri.GetLeftPart(UriPartial.Authority) = scheme+host+port only. DurationMs = final SendAsync duration (after any 401 retry). TraceExporter configDir is injected same as TraceSession. Export file name = '<name>-<uuid[0..7]>.json' when export-path is a directory.

openItems.defaultAssumption: See OQ-009. Allow [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], max 64 chars. Throw ZapiCliException(INVALID_ARGS, 1) on violation. No uniqueness check — names are non-unique by design.
See OQ-010. Named Mutex: 'Global\\zapi-cli-trace-{sessionUniqueId}'. WaitOne(2000) — if timeout, drop the entry silently. ReleaseMutex in finally.

openItems.item: In-flight call tracking for session close
openItems.defaultAssumption: See OQ-012. Status-based drain: set 'closing' under Mutex → wait waitMs ms → set 'closed' under Mutex. TraceWriter drops entries for 'closing' sessions. Guarantee: any call that read 'active' and acquired the Mutex BEFORE the close sets 'closing' will complete its write before close can acquire the Mutex for the 'closing' transition.
Add all three to ErrorCodes with exit 1.
See OQ-013. EntryCount is NOT reset on reopen. IncrementEntryCountAsync reads the current EntryCount from sessions.json and increments — seq continues naturally.
See OQ-014. Remove only deletes the sessions.json entry. Trace file at ExportPath is preserved. No --delete-file flag in Story 8.
